notes.title: Multiplayer servers!
notes.content:

Officers!

Today an important note came from the headquarters: 
[h1]🔥 Due to your numerous requests, we are opening Blitzkrieg 1 and Blitzkrieg 2 multiplayer servers on 27th of July 2018! 🔥[/h1]

Participate in the legendary battles of the World War II, become a skilled general and gain fame among the fellow players in multiplayer mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/eaa65b3d7ba4ef115099254589745b652cb5cfc2.png[/img]

[h1]In order to play on the new multiplayer servers, press 'Galaxy' button in the menu:[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4596683/eaa65b3d7ba4ef115099254589745b652cb5cfc2.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/235380/ss_2969fb34f4d71af55d450efb73024389a224db7f.1920x1080.jpg?t=1509620720[/img]

Good day to you, recruits!

[h1]Today we are launching Blitzkrieg 3 Demo Version. [/h1]
Demo Version will allow you to experience many features from the full version to make up your mind about the game.

[h1][b]What is available in the Demo:[/b][/h1]

[h1]1) 38 full-blown missions out of 70 available in full version[/h1]

[h1]2) Access to one of the game's PvP modes - Skirmish (1x1, 2x2 and 3x3)[/h1]
This classic to RTS mode is the only place where you will be able to receive rewards for winning. The only exception is rewards granted for completing missions. 

[h1]3) Full unit park of the game[/h1]
You will be able to command all units from the full version! To receive access to units from Era 2 and Era 3, you need to move up in our ranking system. You can receive new ranks through fighting in Skirmish battles.

[h1]4) Ability to fight versus Boris[/h1]
Boris is our neural artificial intelligence that learns from you, our players, on how to build his tactics! Boris is a very interesting enemy since he never plays the same, yet never uses any unfair information. He plays like a real player!
Please keep in mind that [b]in the Demo version you won't get any rewards for winning against him[/b]. But, through these fights, your units will gain experience and you will also get research points using which you will be able to improve your army. 

[h1]5) Custom game mode[/h1]
In Custom game you will be able to team up with those you want to play with and against with, choose the map you like to fight on and etc.

We hope that bringing up the [b]Demo Version[/b] will make you interested in the game. This is a great opportunity for you to try Blitzkrieg 3 out before purchasing. Try every aspect of the game: PvE, PvP, Boris and Custom game!

[i]Go through the legendary battles of Second World War and be victorious![/i]

notes.title: Blitzkrieg 3 released!
notes.content:
[img]http://static.blitzkrieg.com/News%202017/release/gif.gif[/img]

[i]Dear players,[/i]

[h1]With your help the development of the main part of the game has come to an end. We are pleased to announce that today, June 2, we are celebrating the long-awaited release of Blitzkrieg 3! And we’ve got you to thank for it![/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/235380/Blitzkrieg_3/

Many innovations, such as trenches, mobile fortifications and various technologies, were implemented based on your requests. These solutions allowed us to preserve the atmosphere of the original series. More than 90 new units have appeared during the early access stage, and most of them were your ideas.

The team wants to give special thanks to the players who painstakingly studied historical publications and documents. You’ve helped us achieve a very high level of historical authenticity: your recommendations and comments allowed us to correct more than 800 inaccuracies in graphics, characteristics and balance. Without your help, this would be impossible even with the involvement of historical consultants. 

Your ideas and desire to have a worthy and, most importantly, fair computer opponent prompted us to create Boris, the world's first neural network artificial intelligence for RTS.

Please note that on 1st of June we’ve reset the progress of all accounts.You can now fully appreciate all the numerous innovations and complete all 3 campaigns while enjoying their full-featured final versions, updated graphics and voice-over.

It is also very important for the players to be on an equal footing at the start of the project. Everyone will start from scratch. The outcome of battles will be determined by tactics rather than an endless reserve of machinery! However, your previous experience will undoubtedly become an advantage.
The game’s development does not stop there, and all your wishes and comments are still very important for the Blitzkrieg 3 team and will be taken into account when developing the game further!

Do not hesitate to use any of the available channels to contact us.
[b]The release of Blitzkrieg 3 is our unite victory, friends![/b]

[i]Sincerely,
Blitzkrieg 3 development team[/i]
